practicePrompts: [TASK] Tulis 3 kalimat tentang kegiatanmu kemarin menggunakan Past Simple. [HINT] Ingat kata kerja tidak beraturan seperti went, ate, saw.

quiz.question: Choose the uncountable noun.

I carrying that bag for you

quiz.question: We ___ not sure yet, but we will decide soon, InshaAllah.

quiz.question: Choose the correct short answer: "Will you come?" — "Yes, I ___."

quiz.question: He ___ not going to change his plans now.

quiz.question: Choose the correct question about frequency.

How often does you read Qur'an?

quiz.question: She goes to the doctor ___ a year.
quiz.explanation: 'Once a year' adalah frasa keterangan waktu yang benar untuk menyatakan 1 kali.

quiz.question: I visit my grandparents ___ a month.
quiz.explanation: 'Twice a month' adalah bentuk yang benar untuk menyatakan 2 kali (bukan 'two times a month' walau itu juga dipakai, 'twice' lebih baku).

quiz.question: He is ___ punctual; he always arrives on time.
quiz.explanation: 'Always' menunjukkan konsistensi (Istiqomah) dalam ketepatan waktu.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "She is sometimes tired, but is always grateful."
quiz.explanation: Kalimat ini sudah benar; adverb frequency diletakkan setelah To Be.

quiz.question: Choose the correct order: 30%, 70%, 90%, 100%.
quiz.explanation: Urutan intensitas dari rendah ke tinggi: sometimes (30%), often (70%), usually (90%), always (100%).

quiz.question: I ___ skip Fajr prayer; it's very rare.
quiz.explanation: 'Rarely' diletakkan sebelum kata kerja utama untuk menunjukkan frekuensi jarang.

quiz.question: We meet our relatives ___ during Eid.
quiz.explanation: 'Every year' adalah frasa keterangan waktu yang tepat.

quiz.question: He is ___ absent from class; it's very unusual.
quiz.explanation: 'Never' berarti 0% frekuensi, diletakkan setelah To Be.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence about consistent good habits (Istiqomah).
options: I always try to be honest, even in small things
I sometimes always try to be honest
I try always to be honest
I always trying to be honest
quiz.explanation: 'Always' sebelum kata kerja utama 'try' menunjukkan konsistensi.

quiz.question: ___ do you go to the gym?
quiz.explanation: 'How often' adalah frasa tanya yang benar untuk menanyakan frekuensi.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "He usually is on time."
quiz.explanation: Setelah To Be, adverb of frequency diletakkan sesudahnya: 'is usually'.

quiz.question: I read the Qur'an ___ before sleeping.
quiz.explanation: 'Every night' adalah frasa keterangan waktu yang tepat.

quiz.question: She ___ complains; she is very patient.
quiz.explanation: 'Rarely' menunjukkan frekuensi rendah, diletakkan sebelum kata kerja utama 'complains'.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence about small, consistent good deeds.
options: The best deeds are the ones done consistently, even if small
The best deeds are always the biggest ones
The best deeds are sometimes small
The best deeds are never small
quiz.explanation: Dalam Islam, amal yang dicintai Allah adalah yang dilakukan secara Istiqomah (konsisten) meski sedikit.

quiz.question: We ___ pray together as a family in the evening.
quiz.explanation: 'Often' adalah adverb of frequency yang benar, tanpa akhiran tambahan.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "I am never late, I always on time."
quiz.explanation: Setelah To Be, adverb frequency diletakkan sesudahnya: 'am always'.

quiz.question: He calls his parents ___ a week to check on them.
quiz.explanation: 'Once a week' adalah frasa yang benar untuk 1 kali dalam seminggu.

quiz.question: Choose the correct question about someone's prayer habit.
options: How often does she pray at the mosque?
How often she does pray at the mosque?
How often she pray at the mosque?
How often is she pray at the mosque?
quiz.explanation: Struktur: How often + does + subject + base verb.

quiz.question: I ___ forget my promises; keeping promises is important.
quiz.explanation: 'Rarely' diletakkan sebelum kata kerja utama 'forget'.

quiz.question: She volunteers at the charity ___ a month.
quiz.explanation: 'Twice a month' adalah bentuk baku untuk menyatakan 2 kali sebulan.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "Always she helps others."
quiz.explanation: Adverb of frequency 'always' diletakkan setelah subjek dan sebelum kata kerja utama.

quiz.question: He is ___ honest, even when it's difficult.
quiz.explanation: 'Always' setelah To Be menunjukkan konsistensi sifat jujur.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence about a rare bad habit.
options: He is rarely lose his temper
quiz.explanation: 'Rarely' diletakkan sebelum kata kerja utama 'loses'.

quiz.question: We should strive to be ___ grateful, not just when things are easy.
quiz.explanation: 'Always' menunjukkan sikap syukur yang konsisten dalam segala kondisi.

practicePrompts: [TASK] Tulis 3 kalimat tentang kebiasaan baikmu menggunakan always/usually/often. [HINT] Letakkan sebelum kata kerja utama, atau sesudah To Be.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat tentang hal yang jarang/tidak pernah kamu lakukan menggunakan rarely/never. [HINT] Perhatikan posisinya dalam kalimat.

[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat tentang konsistensi (Istiqomah) dalam ibadah menggunakan always. [HINT] Amal kecil yang konsisten lebih baik daripada besar tapi jarang.

quiz.question: You look tired. You ___ get some rest.
quiz.explanation: 'Should' dipakai untuk memberi saran, bukan perintah.

quiz.question: According to the law, you ___ wear a helmet on a motorcycle.
quiz.explanation: 'Must' dipakai untuk kewajiban mutlak dari otoritas/aturan.

quiz.question: I ___ finish this report by tomorrow; my boss requires it.
quiz.explanation: 'Have to' dipakai untuk kewajiban karena situasi/aturan eksternal.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "He must to attend the meeting."
quiz.explanation: Setelah modal verb 'must', kata kerja dasar tanpa 'to'.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "She shoulds study harder."
quiz.explanation: Modal verbs tidak pernah menambahkan '-s' untuk subjek apa pun.

quiz.question: You ___ smoke here; it's against the rules.
quiz.explanation: 'Mustn't' menyatakan larangan tegas berdasarkan aturan.

quiz.question: I don't think it's a good idea; you ___ tell a lie.
quiz.explanation: 'Shouldn't' dipakai untuk memberi nasihat agar tidak melakukan sesuatu.

quiz.question: In Islam, Muslims ___ pray five times a day; it is an obligation.
quiz.explanation: 'Must' menunjukkan kewajiban mutlak, sesuai kewajiban shalat dalam Islam.

quiz.question: Because of the traffic, I ___ leave earlier than usual today.
quiz.explanation: 'Have to' dipakai untuk kewajiban akibat situasi (macet).

quiz.question: Choose the gentle advice sentence.
options: You must drink more water (too strong for advice)
You have to drink more water (too strong)
quiz.explanation: 'Should' terdengar lebih lembut sebagai saran dibanding 'must' atau 'have to'.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "You must to respect your parents."
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'must', kata kerja dasar tanpa 'to'.

quiz.question: We ___ waste food; it's forbidden in Islam (Israf).
quiz.explanation: 'Mustn't' menunjukkan larangan tegas terhadap pemborosan (Israf).

quiz.question: You don't ___ come if you're busy; it's optional.
quiz.explanation: 'Don't have to' menunjukkan tidak ada kewajiban (opsional), berbeda dari 'mustn't' yang berarti larangan.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence about a moral obligation from within.
options: I must help my parents; it's my duty
I should help my parents (weaker obligation)
I will help my parents (just intention)
quiz.explanation: 'Must' menunjukkan kewajiban kuat yang datang dari dalam diri, seperti kewajiban berbakti pada orang tua.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "Does he have to to leave now?"
options: Does he have to leave now?
Does he has to leave now?
Do he have to leave now?
Does he must to leave now?
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'have to' dalam pertanyaan dengan 'does', tidak perlu 'to' tambahan dan kata kerja dasar.

quiz.question: You ___ apologize; it would show good character.
quiz.explanation: 'Should' menyarankan tindakan yang baik (meminta maaf).

quiz.question: In this school, students ___ wear the uniform every day.
quiz.explanation: 'Have to' menunjukkan kewajiban berdasarkan aturan sekolah.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence giving sincere advice (Nasihat).
options: You should be patient during hardship
You must be patient during hardship (too commanding for advice)
You have to be patient during hardship (too commanding)
You will be patient during hardship
quiz.explanation: 'Should' cocok untuk nasihat yang lembut, sesuai adab dalam menasihati saudara.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "We must not to lie to each other."
options: We must not lie to each other
We must not lies to each other
We musts not lie to each other
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'must not', kata kerja dasar tanpa 'to'.

quiz.question: You ___ ask for permission before entering someone's room.
quiz.explanation: 'Should' menyarankan adab meminta izin sebelum masuk ruangan orang lain.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence about a rule set by an external authority.
options: Passengers should fasten their seatbelts (weaker, less rule-like)
quiz.explanation: 'Must' cocok untuk aturan resmi dari otoritas luar (peraturan penerbangan).

quiz.question: I ___ not attend today; I have an important family matter.
quiz.explanation: 'Don't have to' or 'have to not' bentuknya sedikit berbeda, namun dalam konteks ini 'have to' + reasoning menunjukkan kewajiban mendesak karena situasi.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "You should to be honest all the time."
options: You should be honest all the time
You should honest all the time
You should being honest all the time
You shoulds be honest all the time
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'should', kata kerja dasar tanpa 'to'.

quiz.question: Children ___ obey their parents in matters of good (Ma'ruf).
quiz.explanation: 'Must' menekankan kewajiban kuat berbakti kepada orang tua dalam kebaikan.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence about a situational obligation.
options: Because it's raining, we have to stay inside
Because it's raining, we must stay inside (equally fine, but 'have to' fits situational cause better)
Because it's raining, we should stay inside (weaker)
Because it's raining, we will stay inside
quiz.explanation: 'Have to' paling pas untuk kewajiban yang muncul dari situasi eksternal (hujan).

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "He have to finishes his work."
options: He has to finish his work
He have to finish his work
He has to finishes his work
He have to finishing his work
quiz.explanation: Subjek tunggal 'He' memakai 'has to', dan kata kerja setelahnya dalam bentuk dasar.

quiz.question: We ___ backbite (Ghibah) about others; it is a major sin.
quiz.explanation: 'Mustn't' menunjukkan larangan tegas terhadap ghibah, karena termasuk dosa besar.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence expressing gentle guidance among brothers in faith.
options: We should remind each other with kindness
We must remind each other harshly
We have to remind each other loudly
We will remind each other only once
quiz.explanation: 'Should' + kelembutan mencerminkan adab dalam saling menasehati (Tashiyah).

quiz.question: You don't ___ answer if you don't want to; it's your choice.
quiz.explanation: 'Don't have to' menunjukkan tidak ada kewajiban, berbeda makna dari larangan.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "I musts always tell the truth."
options: I must always tell the truth
I must always tells the truth
I musts always tells the truth
I must to always tell the truth
quiz.explanation: Modal verb 'must' tidak pernah ditambahkan '-s' untuk subjek apa pun.

practicePrompts: [TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat memberi saran lembut kepada temanmu menggunakan should. [HINT] Should terdengar lebih lembut dibanding must.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat tentang kewajiban mutlak (dari agama atau hukum) menggunakan must. [HINT] Must untuk keharusan yang kuat.

quiz.question: She walked ___ the room to greet her guests.
quiz.explanation: 'Into' dipakai saat gerakan memasuki ruang tertutup.

quiz.question: He ran ___ the house when he heard the news.
quiz.explanation: 'Out of' menunjukkan gerakan keluar dari ruang tertutup.

quiz.question: The bird flew ___ from the cage.
quiz.explanation: 'Away from' menunjukkan gerakan menjauh dari suatu titik.

quiz.question: Please take your shoes ___ before entering the mosque.
quiz.explanation: 'Off' dipakai untuk melepaskan sesuatu dari tubuh/permukaan.

quiz.question: We walked ___ the forest to reach the village.
quiz.explanation: 'Through' dipakai untuk gerakan melewati ruang 3D seperti hutan.

quiz.question: She swam ___ the river to the other side.
quiz.explanation: 'Across' dipakai untuk gerakan melewati permukaan 2D seperti sungai/jalan.

quiz.question: He walked ___ the mosque without stopping to pray.
quiz.explanation: 'Past' dipakai untuk gerakan melewati sesuatu tanpa berhenti.

quiz.question: The children ran ___ the stairs to the rooftop.
quiz.explanation: 'Up' dipakai untuk gerakan vertikal naik.

quiz.question: The ball rolled ___ the hill.
quiz.explanation: 'Down' dipakai untuk gerakan vertikal turun.

quiz.question: The cat jumped ___ the fence to the other side.
quiz.explanation: 'Over' dipakai untuk gerakan melompati sesuatu dari posisi lebih tinggi.

quiz.question: The Prophet migrated (Hijrah) ___ Madinah from Mecca.
quiz.explanation: 'To' adalah preposisi paling umum untuk menunjukkan tujuan akhir perjalanan.

options: He walked to the room (already correct if just approaching)
He walked past the room (wrong meaning)

quiz.question: He drove ___ from the accident scene to call for help.
quiz.explanation: 'Away' menunjukkan gerakan menjauh dari suatu tempat.

quiz.question: The travelers (Musafir) journeyed ___ the desert for many days.
options: across (also acceptable, but through fits 3D vast area)

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence about leaving a closed space.
options: He walked out of the classroom
He walked into the classroom (wrong direction)

quiz.question: The plane flew ___ the clouds.
quiz.explanation: 'Through' dipakai untuk gerakan melewati ruang 3D seperti awan.

quiz.question: He climbed ___ the ladder to fix the roof.
quiz.explanation: 'Up' dipakai untuk gerakan vertikal naik.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence about crossing a street safely.

Look both ways before walking through the street
Look both ways before walking past the street
Look both ways before walking into the street
quiz.explanation: 'Across' dipakai untuk melewati permukaan 2D seperti jalan.

quiz.question: The travelers (Musafir) journeyed far ___ their hometown for the sake of knowledge.
quiz.explanation: 'Away from'/'from' menunjukkan jarak dari titik asal.

quiz.question: He jumped ___ the pool to cool off.
quiz.explanation: 'Into' dipakai untuk gerakan masuk ke dalam air/ruang.

quiz.question: She got ___ the car and drove away.
quiz.explanation: 'Into' dipakai untuk gerakan masuk ke dalam sesuatu, termasuk kendaraan.

quiz.question: He took the picture frame ___ the wall to clean it.
quiz.explanation: 'Off' dipakai untuk melepaskan sesuatu dari permukaan.

quiz.question: The children walked ___ the bridge to cross the river.

quiz.explanation: 'Across' dipakai untuk melintasi permukaan seperti jembatan.

quiz.question: He walked ___ his old school on his way home; memories came back.
quiz.explanation: 'Past' dipakai untuk melewati sesuatu tanpa masuk ke dalamnya.

Hijrah means walking past a place
Hijrah means climbing over a place
Hijrah means swimming through a place

quiz.question: The waves crashed ___ the rocks near the shore.
quiz.explanation: 'Into'/'against' dipakai untuk gerakan yang mengenai/menabrak sesuatu.

quiz.question: He fell ___ the stairs and hurt his leg.
quiz.explanation: 'Down' dipakai untuk gerakan vertikal jatuh/turun.

quiz.question: She walked ___ the crowd to find her friend.
quiz.explanation: 'Through' dipakai untuk gerakan melewati kerumunan (ruang penuh objek).

quiz.question: ___ the door, please.
quiz.explanation: Imperative memakai bentuk dasar kata kerja tanpa subjek.

quiz.question: ___ talk during the lesson.
quiz.explanation: Larangan pada imperative memakai 'Don't' + kata kerja dasar.

quiz.question: ___ right at the next corner.

quiz.question: ___ quiet in the library.

quiz.question: ___ litter in public places; it harms the environment.
quiz.explanation: Larangan memakai 'Don't' + kata kerja dasar.

quiz.question: Choose the gentle command using 'please' at the end.
quiz.explanation: 'Please' bisa diletakkan di awal atau akhir kalimat perintah untuk kesantunan.

quiz.question: ___ your voice down; people are sleeping.
quiz.explanation: Imperative memakai bentuk dasar kata kerja 'keep'.

quiz.question: Giving good directions to a stranger is considered:

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "Please to help me with this."
quiz.explanation: Imperative dengan 'please' tetap memakai kata kerja dasar tanpa 'to'.

quiz.question: ___ across at the pedestrian crossing.
quiz.explanation: Arahan menggunakan bentuk dasar kata kerja 'walk'.

Going past the bakery, then turning right
Went past the bakery, then turned right
quiz.explanation: Arahan jalan berurutan tetap memakai bentuk dasar kata kerja.

quiz.question: ___ waste food; it is forbidden (Israf) in Islam.

quiz.explanation: Setelah 'Don't', kata kerja dasar tanpa 'to', termasuk 'be' untuk To Be.

quiz.question: ___ your neighbor if they need any help.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence about guiding someone toward good (Amr Ma'ruf).

Please remembers to pray on time

quiz.explanation: Nasihat lembut memakai imperative dengan 'please' + kata kerja dasar.

quiz.question: ___ the stairs carefully; they can be slippery.

options: Turn left at the traffic light
Turning left at the traffic light
Turned left at the traffic light
To turn left at the traffic light

quiz.question: ___ patient; good things take time.
quiz.explanation: Imperative dengan To Be memakai bentuk dasar 'be'.

Walks straight, then turns right at the corner
Walked straight, then turned right at the corner

quiz.question: ___ kind to your younger siblings.
quiz.explanation: Imperative dengan To Be selalu memakai bentuk dasar 'be'.

options: Please don't be late next time
Please not be late next time
Please doesn't be late next time
Please isn't be late next time

quiz.question: ___ the window before you leave the room.
quiz.explanation: Imperative memakai bentuk dasar kata kerja 'close'.

options: Please guide them with patience and kindness
quiz.explanation: Bimbingan yang baik (dakwah) disampaikan dengan lembut, memakai imperative dasar.

quiz.question: ___ honest, even if it is difficult.
quiz.explanation: Imperative dengan To Be memakai bentuk dasar 'be'.

quiz.question: Choose the correct structure for Past Continuous.
quiz.explanation: Rumus Past Continuous adalah was/were + Verb-ing.

quiz.question: ___ you sleeping when I called last night?
quiz.explanation: Subjek 'you' memakai 'Were' untuk pertanyaan Past Continuous.

quiz.question: I ___ cooking when the fire alarm went off.
quiz.explanation: Subjek 'I' memakai 'was' untuk Past Continuous.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "She was study when I arrived."
options: She was studying when I arrived
She were studying when I arrived
She was studies when I arrived
quiz.explanation: Past Continuous membutuhkan Verb-ing, bukan bentuk dasar.

quiz.question: While I ___ walking home, I met my old friend.
quiz.explanation: 'While' menunjukkan aksi panjang yang sedang berlangsung, memakai Past Continuous 'was'.

quiz.question: When the guest arrived, we ___ preparing dinner.
quiz.explanation: Subjek jamak 'We' memakai 'were' untuk aksi panjang yang sedang berlangsung.

quiz.question: Choose the correct use of When (short action) and While (long action).
options: I was reading when the phone rang
I read while the phone was ringing (wrong emphasis)
I was reading while the phone rang (less natural)
I read when the phone was ringing (less natural)
quiz.explanation: 'When' dipakai untuk aksi pendek (Past Simple: rang) yang menginterupsi aksi panjang (Past Continuous: was reading).

quiz.question: The sun ___ shining brightly when we started our journey.
quiz.explanation: 'The sun' subjek tunggal memakai 'was' untuk mendeskripsikan suasana (setting the scene).

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "What were you doing when it happens?"
options: What were you doing when it happened?
What was you doing when it happened?
What were you do when it happened?
What did you doing when it happened?
quiz.explanation: Aksi pendek yang menginterupsi memakai Past Simple 'happened', bukan present 'happens'.

quiz.question: I ___ reciting Qur'an when my phone buzzed.
quiz.explanation: Subjek 'I' memakai 'was' untuk aksi panjang yang sedang berlangsung.

quiz.question: They ___ traveling to Mecca when they heard the good news.
quiz.explanation: Subjek jamak 'They' memakai 'were' untuk Past Continuous.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence describing a background scene.
options: The birds were singing and the wind was blowing gently
The birds sang and the wind blew gently (Past Simple, different focus)
The birds sing and the wind blows gently
The birds are singing and the wind is blowing
quiz.explanation: Past Continuous cocok untuk mendeskripsikan suasana/latar belakang cerita.

quiz.question: He ___ working hard when his effort finally paid off.
quiz.explanation: Subjek tunggal 'He' memakai 'was' untuk aksi panjang yang sedang berlangsung.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "I was learn English while I lived abroad."
options: I was learning English while I lived abroad
I learn English while I was living abroad (reversed emphasis)
I learning English while I lived abroad
I was learned English while I lived abroad
quiz.explanation: Aksi panjang membutuhkan Verb-ing: 'was learning'.

quiz.question: While she ___ preparing food, her brother was setting the table.
quiz.explanation: Subjek tunggal 'she' memakai 'was' untuk dua aksi panjang yang berlangsung bersamaan.

quiz.question: This tense reminds us that life is a continuous process, symbolized by:
quiz.explanation: 'I was learning' mengingatkan bahwa usaha adalah proses yang berkelanjutan.

quiz.question: ___ they studying together when you saw them?
quiz.explanation: Subjek jamak 'they' memakai 'Were' untuk pertanyaan Past Continuous.

quiz.question: I ___ not paying attention when the teacher explained the rule.
quiz.explanation: Subjek 'I' memakai 'was' untuk negasi Past Continuous.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence about an interrupted long action.
options: I was sleeping when the earthquake happened
I slept when the earthquake was happening (reversed emphasis)
I was sleeping when the earthquake was happening (double continuous, less precise)
I sleep when the earthquake happened
quiz.explanation: Aksi panjang (was sleeping) diinterupsi oleh aksi pendek (happened, Past Simple).

quiz.question: We ___ discussing the plan when the call came in.
quiz.explanation: Subjek jamak 'We' memakai 'were' untuk Past Continuous.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "She was cook dinner when I visited."
options: She was cooking dinner when I visited
She were cooking dinner when I visited
She cooking dinner when I visited
She was cooked dinner when I visited
quiz.explanation: Past Continuous membutuhkan Verb-ing: 'was cooking'.

quiz.question: The children ___ playing quietly when their father came home.
quiz.explanation: Subjek jamak 'children' memakai 'were'.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence emphasizing an ongoing effort in the past.
options: I was trying my best, even though it was hard
I try my best (present, different focus)
I tried my best (simple, less emphasis on ongoing effort)
quiz.explanation: Past Continuous 'was trying' menekankan proses usaha yang sedang berlangsung.

quiz.question: While I ___ listening to the lecture, I took some notes.
quiz.explanation: Subjek 'I' memakai 'was' untuk aksi panjang (listening), sementara 'took notes' adalah aksi pendek (Past Simple).

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "Were she waiting for you at the station?"
options: Was she waiting for you at the station?
Were she wait for you at the station?
Did she waiting for you at the station?
Was she wait for you at the station?
quiz.explanation: Subjek tunggal 'she' memakai 'Was', bukan 'Were'.

quiz.question: He ___ reflecting on his blessings when he felt truly grateful.
quiz.explanation: Subjek tunggal 'He' memakai 'was' untuk aksi panjang yang sedang berlangsung.

quiz.question: Choose the correct negative Past Continuous sentence.
quiz.explanation: Negasi Past Continuous: was/were + not, disingkat wasn't/weren't.

quiz.question: They ___ waiting patiently when the Imam finally arrived.
quiz.explanation: Subjek jamak 'They' memakai 'were' untuk Past Continuous.

practicePrompts: [TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat tentang apa yang sedang kamu lakukan ketika sesuatu terjadi, menggunakan Past Continuous + Past Simple. [HINT] was/were + Verb-ing untuk aksi panjang, Past Simple untuk aksi pendek yang menginterupsi.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat mendeskripsikan suasana masa lalu (cuaca, keadaan sekitar) menggunakan Past Continuous. [HINT] Cocok untuk membuka sebuah cerita.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat menggunakan While untuk dua aksi panjang yang berlangsung bersamaan. [HINT] While + was/were + Verb-ing, was/were + Verb-ing.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat tentang usaha yang sedang kamu lakukan di masa lalu menggunakan Past Continuous. [HINT] Menekankan proses, bukan hasil akhir.
[TASK] Tulis 2 pertanyaan menggunakan Was/Were untuk menanyakan apa yang sedang dilakukan seseorang di waktu tertentu. [HINT] Was untuk tunggal, Were untuk jamak/you.

quiz.question: I ___ visited Turkey before.
quiz.explanation: Subjek 'I' memakai 'have' untuk Present Perfect.

quiz.question: She ___ never eaten this kind of food.
quiz.explanation: Subjek tunggal 'She' memakai 'has' untuk Present Perfect.

quiz.question: ___ you ever been to Mecca?
quiz.explanation: Subjek 'you' memakai 'Have' untuk pertanyaan Present Perfect.

quiz.question: He ___ never lied to his parents.
quiz.explanation: Subjek tunggal 'He' memakai 'has' untuk Present Perfect.

quiz.question: Choose the correct structure of Present Perfect.
quiz.explanation: Rumus Present Perfect adalah have/has + Past Participle (Verb 3).

quiz.question: I ___ finished my homework already.
quiz.explanation: Subjek 'I' memakai 'have' untuk Present Perfect.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "I have went to Turkey."
quiz.explanation: 'Gone' adalah bentuk Verb 3 (Past Participle) dari 'go', bukan 'went' (Verb 2).

quiz.question: They ___ never visited this city before.
quiz.explanation: Subjek jamak 'They' memakai 'have' untuk Present Perfect.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence with a specific past time (should use Past Simple, not Present Perfect).
quiz.explanation: Karena ada waktu spesifik 'last year', kalimat ini harus memakai Past Simple, bukan Present Perfect.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "Has you ever tried this dish?"
options: Have you ever tried this dish?
Has you ever try this dish?
Have you ever tries this dish?
Did you have ever tried this dish?
quiz.explanation: Subjek 'you' memakai 'Have', bukan 'Has'.

quiz.question: She ___ read this book twice already.
quiz.explanation: Subjek tunggal 'She' memakai 'has'.

quiz.question: Alhamdulillah, I ___ received many blessings in my life.
quiz.explanation: Subjek 'I' memakai 'have' untuk mengekspresikan syukur atas pengalaman hidup.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence using 'ever' in a question.
options: Have you ever prayed at the Grand Mosque?
Have you prayed ever at the Grand Mosque?
You have ever prayed at the Grand Mosque?
Have ever you prayed at the Grand Mosque?
quiz.explanation: 'Ever' diletakkan setelah subjek dan sebelum kata kerja utama dalam pertanyaan Present Perfect.

quiz.question: I ___ never traveled outside my country.
quiz.explanation: Subjek 'I' memakai 'have', dan 'never' menunjukkan tidak pernah melakukan sesuatu.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "We have saw this movie before."
options: We have seen this movie before
We has seen this movie before
We have see this movie before
We have sees this movie before
quiz.explanation: 'Seen' adalah bentuk Verb 3 dari 'see', bukan 'saw' (Verb 2).

quiz.question: He ___ completed the Qur'an memorization program.
quiz.explanation: Subjek tunggal 'He' memakai 'has'.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence expressing gratitude for an achievement.
options: I have accomplished so much, alhamdulillah
I accomplished so much yesterday, alhamdulillah (specific time needs Past Simple)
quiz.explanation: Tanpa waktu spesifik, 'I have accomplished' tepat untuk menyatakan pengalaman/pencapaian secara umum.

quiz.question: ___ she ever visited her grandparents' village?
quiz.explanation: Subjek tunggal 'she' memakai 'Has' untuk pertanyaan Present Perfect.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "I have ate dinner already."
quiz.explanation: 'Eaten' adalah bentuk Verb 3 dari 'eat', bukan 'ate' (Verb 2).

quiz.question: We ___ learned so many valuable lessons this year.
quiz.explanation: Subjek jamak 'We' memakai 'have'.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence correctly distinguishing Present Perfect from Past Simple.
options: I have visited Egypt (no specific time) vs. I visited Egypt in 2019 (specific time)
I visited Egypt (no time) vs. I have visited Egypt in 2019 (specific time, wrong)
Both sentences mean exactly the same in every context
Present Perfect always needs a specific time
quiz.explanation: Present Perfect dipakai tanpa waktu spesifik, sedangkan Past Simple dipakai dengan waktu spesifik seperti 'in 2019'.

quiz.question: He ___ never broken a promise in his life.
quiz.explanation: Subjek tunggal 'He' memakai 'has'.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "Has they finished the project?"
options: Did they have finished the project?
quiz.explanation: Subjek jamak 'they' memakai 'Have', bukan 'Has'.

quiz.question: I ___ counted my blessings many times, and I am always amazed.
quiz.explanation: Subjek 'I' memakai 'have' untuk pengalaman berulang tanpa waktu spesifik.

quiz.question: Choose the correct answer to "Have you ever been to Madinah?"
quiz.explanation: Jawaban singkat Present Perfect mengikuti 'have/has' yang dipakai di pertanyaan.

quiz.question: She ___ worked here since last year (still working now).
quiz.explanation: Subjek tunggal 'She' memakai 'has', menunjukkan sesuatu yang berlanjut hingga sekarang.

quiz.question: Fix the mistake: "They have never went abroad."
quiz.explanation: 'Gone' adalah bentuk Verb 3 dari 'go', bukan 'went'.

quiz.question: I ___ not tried that food before; is it good?
quiz.explanation: Subjek 'I' memakai 'have' untuk negasi Present Perfect 'have not'.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence that correctly reflects on life experiences with gratitude.
options: I have experienced many trials, and Allah has always helped me through
I experience many trials yesterday (grammatically odd)
I will experience many trials (future, different meaning)
I am experiencing many trials right now (present continuous, different meaning)
quiz.explanation: Present Perfect cocok untuk merefleksikan pengalaman hidup secara keseluruhan hingga saat ini.

quiz.question: We ___ never forgotten his kindness.
quiz.explanation: Subjek jamak 'We' memakai 'have'.

practicePrompts: [TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat tentang pengalaman yang pernah kamu lakukan menggunakan have/has + ever. [HINT] Tanpa menyebutkan waktu spesifik.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat tentang hal yang belum pernah kamu lakukan menggunakan have/has + never. [HINT] Never berarti tidak pernah sama sekali.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat bersyukur (Tahaddus bin Ni'mah) atas pencapaian hidupmu menggunakan Present Perfect. [HINT] Fokus pada pengalaman secara keseluruhan, bukan waktu spesifik.
[TASK] Tulis 2 pertanyaan menggunakan Have/Has ever untuk menanyakan pengalaman temanmu. [HINT] Have untuk I/you/we/they, Has untuk he/she/it.
[TASK] Tulis 2 kalimat yang membandingkan Present Perfect (tanpa waktu) dan Past Simple (dengan waktu spesifik). [HINT] Contoh: I have visited... vs I visited... last year.
